newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet meets on employment, accounts.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet meets on employment, accounts.

text.p: The cabinet of Prime Minister Romano Prodi began a meeting on Friday to discuss measures to boost employment.
Political sources said the ministers were also expected to discuss quarterly state accounts, although this was not on the formal agenda.
Cabinet secretary Enrico Micheli said on Thursday that the quarterly accounts, which will determine the size of a cost-cutting mini-budget, should be presented by the end of the week.
The mini-budget, which Italian state television said would be more than 15 trillion lire, is expected to be approved by the end of the month.
